case.summary: Verdict: uncertain. The single transaction (txn 3534820, card C09988-K1, customer C09988, $59.67 online on 2016-12-11) loosely fits pattern 3 (card-not-present from a new device, id_15='New'), but the amount and product ('C') are consistent with the customer's 52-transaction history (mean $38.21, all online), and the fraud probability (0.68) sits just below the 0.70 threshold. Key evidence is the New device flag on an online purchase; no shared device, region, or confirmed-fraud links were found, though the hotmail.com email cluster spans 25 cards. Recommended action per R1: VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER (or STEP_UP_AUTH) before any block; no card block warranted on this weak single signal.
